claims.scope: Three mutually independent source blocks; d>1 dimensional hub density cap M0; two full-rank d-dimensional arm images with marginal caps M1,M2; arbitrary internal measurable phases; no direct arm-arm coupling.
claims.conclusion: Continuous C0 density with supnorm <= d/(d-1) M0^(1/d)(M1 M2)^(1/(2d)).

claims.scope: Two original physical hub coordinates, two disjoint cap-one product banks, rank-two physical hub-to-bank arms with singular-volume products S1,S2, arbitrary same-bank and hub curvature, no light-light cross term.
claims.conclusion: Continuous C0 density with supnorm <= 2 sqrt(2)(S1 S2)^(-1/4).

claims.scope: r43 diffuse bisection arm-volume bounds plus exactly zero common-plane light-light edge and zero transverse tail.
Two physical hubs joined to two diffuse rank-two arm banks, each arm singular values L,L; L>=1/sqrt(2).
claims.conclusion: Matrix has four eigenvalues of modulus >=1 and output density <=2sqrt(2)/L; at threshold L=1/sqrt(2), <=4.
